source.provenance: Fan-made: its players' abilities are Simon Treanor's. Its readme calls it a beta in which many teams keep squads of the early 2000s, and names the English, Scottish, German and Italian leagues as complete. Its nationalities are today's (Ukraine, Croatia, Slovakia, East Germans as 'Germany'), so the season plays the federations of 1989/90: the Soviet Union, Yugoslavia and Czechoslovakia field their republics' players, and a 'Germany' player at an East German club plays for no nation (noNationAt). Nations only: its Spanish and Portuguese first divisions are 1989/90's (1989-90 La Liga and 1989-90 Primeira Divisão on Wikipedia, revisions 1337764526 and 1374234667), but Logroñés (7 rated players), Castellón and Tenerife (10 each) and eight of Portugal's eighteen (Chaves, Feirense, Marítimo, Nacional, Penafiel, Portimonense, Tirsense, União da Madeira) cannot field eleven.
